round_trip.criteria: Our evaluator and router on the raw reference reproduce the paper's own numbers: temperature within 1 K and routed wire within 2% (room #56739, item (b)2).

prerequisites: a named warden grant for the solves
the paper's statistic: max of chip-layer unit temperatures with -grid_map_mode center at 64x64 (our J, the grid peak with max, stays a diagnostic)
the paper's package physics: HotSpot 6.0 vertical coupling, or a reviewed fix (SLAB-049 CAL-COUPLING)
a fixture that accepts the raw centres: the 45 mm fixtures' 0.5 mm lattice refuses them, and the snapped variant moves dies by up to the max_abs_raw_to_snapped_mm below
temperature.status: PLANNED, NOT RUN: SLAB-048 has no solve grant

wire.note: Routed wire needs no thermal solve. Half a millimetre of digitising error is about 3.7% of Ascend's routed wire (room #56739), so this agreement is what pins the coordinates at the wire level.

snapped.rule: Round every raw centre to the nearest 1 mm grid node, then make the fewest 1 mm moves that make the layout legal on the fixture (margin with halo, halo non-overlap, 0.1 mm minimum body spacing, centre lattice). Ties at that move count go to the layout closest to the raw centres (sum of squared distances), then the lexicographically smallest centres.
